titleTh: คืนตลาดนัดกับ Bogy และ May

scenes.titleTh: ซื้อของที่แผงของ Mali
May หายไปไหน
นัดเจอกันใหม่

goals.labelTh: บอกว่าแค่ดูเฉย ๆ
goals.meaningRubric: Politely says they are only looking / do not need help yet (Just looking, thanks / No, thank you).

hints.intentTh: บอกแม่ค้าว่าแค่ดูเฉย ๆ

goals.meaningRubric: Asks to taste the sweets (Can I try some? / Can I try one?).

hints.intentTh: ขอชิมขนมก่อนซื้อ

goals.meaningRubric: Asks how much the sweets cost (How much is it? / How much is one bag?).

hints.intentTh: ถามราคาขนมหนึ่งถุง

goals.labelTh: ตัดสินใจซื้อ
goals.meaningRubric: Decides to buy with I'll take it / I'll take one bag / Two bags, please. Any clear buying decision is fine.

hints.intentTh: ตัดสินใจซื้อ ใช้ I'll …

goals.labelTh: บอกว่าตัวเองอยู่ตรงไหน
goals.meaningRubric: Says their location with a place word (next to / in front of / opposite / behind / near / at + a place in the market). Invented places are fine.
acceptExamples: I'm next to the big wheel.
I'm standing in front of the food stall.

hints.intentTh: บอก May ว่าคุณอยู่ข้าง ๆ อะไร
hints.modelEn: I'm next to the big wheel.

goals.labelTh: บอกว่ากำลังทำอะไร
goals.labelEn: Say what you are doing now
goals.meaningRubric: Says what they are doing right now with am + -ing (I'm eating / I'm looking for you). A bare -ing verb is close enough.

hints.intentTh: บอกสิ่งที่กำลังทำตอนนี้ ใช้ I'm + -ing

goals.labelTh: บอกว่าใส่ชุดอะไร
goals.meaningRubric: Describes their clothes so May can find them (I'm wearing a red shirt / a blue hat). Colour or clothing word is enough.
acceptExamples: I'm wearing glasses and a white T-shirt.

hints.intentTh: บอกชุดที่ใส่ให้ May หาเจอ

goals.labelTh: ถาม May หนึ่งคำถาม
goals.meaningRubric: Asks May any real question (Where are you? / What are you wearing? / Can you see the big wheel?).
acceptExamples: Can you see the big wheel?

hints.intentTh: ถาม May กลับหนึ่งคำถาม

goals.meaningRubric: Suggests where to meet (Let's meet at the gate / How about the big wheel?).

hints.intentTh: บอกจุดนัดเจอ

goals.labelTh: บอกเวลานัด
goals.meaningRubric: Gives a time to meet (At eight / In ten minutes / At seven fifty).

hints.intentTh: บอกเวลานัด

goals.labelTh: บอกเหตุผลที่มาช้า
goals.meaningRubric: Explains why they are late with because (Because there are so many people / Because I'm buying souvenirs).
acceptExamples: Because there are so many people.
Because the market is very big.

hints.intentTh: บอกเหตุผล ใช้ Because …
hints.modelEn: Because there are so many people.

goals.labelTh: ถาม Teacher Bee หนึ่งคำถาม
goals.meaningRubric: Asks Teacher Bee any real question about the night or the next trip (What are we going to do next? / Where are we going?).
acceptExamples: What are we going to do next?

hints.intentTh: ถาม Teacher Bee หนึ่งคำถาม
hints.modelEn: What are we going to do next?

beats.npcBriefEn: Mali, a friendly night-market seller, greets the learner at her sweet stall. The learner is only looking.
beats.promptEn: Hi, I'm Mali! Welcome to my stall. Can I help you?
beats.promptTh: Mali แม่ค้าใจดีทักว่าให้ช่วยอะไรไหม แต่คุณแค่ดูอยู่
beats.retryEn: Can I help you? You can say: Just looking, thanks.
beats.retryTh: บอกว่าแค่ดูเฉย ๆ ขอบคุณ
praiseEn: Okay, no problem! Take your time.

beats.npcBriefEn: Mali shows a tray of free mango sweets to taste.
beats.promptEn: These are my mango sweets. They're very good!
beats.promptTh: มีถาดขนมมะม่วงให้ชิม ลองขอชิมดู
beats.retryEn: There's a tray. Ask me: Can I try some?
beats.retryTh: ขอชิมด้วย Can I try some?

beats.npcBriefEn: The learner tasted the sweet. Mali waits for them to ask the price.
beats.promptEn: Yummy, right? Do you have a question for me?
beats.promptTh: อร่อย! ถามราคาขนมหนึ่งถุง
beats.retryEn: Ask me the price. How much…?
beats.retryTh: ถามราคาด้วย How much…?

beats.npcBriefEn: One bag costs 80 baht. Mali asks if the learner wants to buy.
beats.promptEn: Eighty baht for one bag. Do you want some?
beats.promptTh: ขนมถุงละ 80 บาท ตัดสินใจซื้อ
beats.retryEn: Do you want it? Say: I'll take it.
beats.retryTh: ตัดสินใจซื้อด้วย I'll take it.
praiseEn: Thank you! Enjoy the night market!

beats.npcBriefEn: May phones the learner. They lost each other in the crowd. There is a big wheel, a gate and food stalls nearby.
beats.promptEn: Hello? It's May! I can't see you. Where are you?
beats.promptTh: May โทรมาเพราะหากันไม่เจอ บอกว่าคุณอยู่ตรงไหน
beats.retryEn: Where are you? Say: I'm next to the…
beats.retryTh: บอกตำแหน่งด้วย I'm next to …

retryGuided.label: big wheel
retryGuided.speak: I'm next to the big wheel.

beats.npcBriefEn: May asks what the learner is doing right now.
beats.promptEn: What are you doing right now?
beats.promptTh: May ถามว่าตอนนี้คุณกำลังทำอะไร
beats.retryEn: Are you eating? Waiting? Say: I'm…ing.

beats.npcBriefEn: There are many people. May asks what the learner is wearing so she can find them.
beats.promptEn: There are so many people here! What are you wearing?
beats.promptTh: คนเยอะมาก บอกชุดที่ใส่ให้ May หาเจอ
beats.retryEn: What colour is your shirt? Say: I'm wearing…
beats.retryTh: บอกชุดด้วย I'm wearing …
praiseEn: Got it! I'm looking for you.

beats.npcBriefEn: May is walking and looking around. The learner asks May one question; May answers it (she is next to a food stall, wearing a yellow dress).
beats.promptEn: I'm walking now… Do you want to ask me something?
beats.promptTh: ถาม May กลับหนึ่งคำถาม
beats.retryEn: Ask me a question. Where…? What…?
beats.retryTh: ตั้งคำถามถาม May หนึ่งข้อ
praiseEn: I'm next to a food stall. I'm wearing a yellow dress.

beats.npcBriefEn: May still can't find the learner. She asks where to meet. Places: gate, big wheel, food stall.
beats.promptEn: This is hard! Where shall we meet?
beats.promptTh: ยังหากันไม่เจอ เสนอจุดนัดเจอ
beats.retryEn: The gate? The big wheel? Say: Let's meet at…
beats.retryTh: นัดจุดเจอด้วย Let's meet at …

beats.npcBriefEn: It is 7:40 now. May asks what time to meet.
beats.promptEn: It's seven forty now. What time?
beats.promptTh: ตอนนี้ 1 ทุ่ม 40 บอกเวลานัด
beats.retryEn: Eight o'clock? In ten minutes? Say: At…
beats.retryTh: บอกเวลานัดด้วย At …

beats.npcBriefEn: At the meeting place Bogy is waiting and teases the learner for being late. The learner gives a reason with because (present tense is fine).
beats.promptEn: Hey, it's Bogy! You're late! Why?
beats.promptTh: Bogy แซวว่ามาช้า บอกเหตุผลด้วย because
beats.retryEn: Why are you late? Say: Because…
beats.retryTh: บอกเหตุผลด้วย Because …

retryGuided.label: many people
retryGuided.speak: Because there are so many people.

praiseEn: Ha! That's true. The market is very busy.

beats.npcBriefEn: Teacher Bee joins the team. Everyone is together. The learner asks Teacher Bee one question; Bee answers that a new teacher and a city trip are coming soon.
beats.promptEn: Everyone is here! Great job, team. Do you have a question for me?
beats.promptTh: ทุกคนมาครบแล้ว ถาม Teacher Bee หนึ่งคำถาม
beats.retryEn: Ask me anything. What are we going to…?
beats.retryTh: ตั้งคำถามถาม Teacher Bee หนึ่งข้อ

retryGuided.label: do next
retryGuided.speak: What are we going to do next?

praiseEn: Good question! We're going to meet a new teacher soon. And then… a trip to the city!

openingEn: Hi, I'm Mali! Welcome to my stall. Can I help you?
openingTh: ภารกิจตลาดนัดกลางคืน: ซื้อของ ตามหา May และนัดเจอทีม
completionEn: Mission complete! You can shop, say where you are, and plan a meeting. Well done!
completionTh: ภารกิจสำเร็จ! คุณซื้อของ บอกตำแหน่งตัวเอง และนัดเจอเพื่อนได้แล้ว เก่งมาก!
